en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large lakeside guesthouse and restaurant with steep gabled roofs, set against a forested hillside. In front of the building is a long terrace crowded with people sitting at tables beneath umbrellas. A pleasure boat full of passengers moves along the reservoir in the foreground. Several early- to mid‑20th‑century automobiles are parked near the building. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image identifying the location.
